entry.title: New: Resolution 439 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF A LATER FISCAL YEAR AND OF MORE THAN ONE FISCAL YEAR FOR A MULTI-YEAR LEASE FOR ONE MULTI-FUNCTION DIGITAL IMAGING DEVICE FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF LIQUOR CONTROL

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a five-year lease agreement with an approximate monthly cost of $300, to be used by the department’s Hilo Office.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 439-24 & FC-145 - 03/06/24
